novelty_assessment.label: largely_addressed
novelty_assessment.reasoning: RepliBench (UK AISI, April 2025) is a comprehensive benchmark that directly evaluates autonomous replication capabilities of LLM agents across four core domains: obtaining resources, exfiltrating model weights, replicating onto compute, and persisting on compute. It covers 20 task families and has been tested on frontier models including Claude 3.7 Sonnet. The idea's core contribution -- benchmarking whether models assist with self-replication -- is substantially covered by RepliBench. The only marginal difference is that RepliBench measures agent capability rather than text-prompt refusal rates, but the overlap is very high.
